name: RC-B10-0173/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text:
The European Parliament welcomes a plan to protect people from second-hand smoke and from aerosols released by e-cigarettes and heated tobacco products. It asks member states to ban smoking and vaping in more outdoor places, such as playgrounds, café terraces, bus stops and areas near hospitals and schools. It also wants more research on the health risks and stronger action against illegal vaping products. The plan is a recommendation, so it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Member states are urged to extend smoking and vaping bans to more outdoor public places.
- **Who it affects:** Smokers, vapers, children, pregnant women, and owners of cafés and restaurants.
- **What happens next:** The Commission reports back to Parliament in four years on progress.
